newsitem.title: ITALY: Banca Pop Milano trading suspended on Milan bourse.
newsitem.headline: Banca Pop Milano trading suspended on Milan bourse.

text.p: Trading in Italian bank Banca Popolare di Milano stock was suspended on the Milan bourse for Monday and Tuesday pending an announcement, stock market regulator Consob said.
Banking sources said the suspension was linked to Banca Popolare's decision earlier this month to incorporate two of its subsidiaries, Banca Agricola Milanese and Banca Briantea.
The share swap ratio is due to be set and announced after the Bank of Italy gives its approval to the plan.
